steps:
The newest health.json that Prometheus read is more than 10 min old, or Prometheus read none in 15 min. No samples here means no read.

1. Compare the public file with the exporter's reads. factory_health_read_success 0 means the exporter cannot read the URL.
curl -s https://factory-data.jomcgi.dev/health.json
kubectl -n prometheus logs deploy/health-exporter

2. If the public generatedAt is old, check the writer and the mirror. The health CronJob writes every 2 min; the mirror copies every minute.
kubectl -n factory-public get cronjob health factory-public-factory-public-mirror
kubectl -n factory-public get jobs --sort-by=.status.startTime
If a mirror Job's log shows R2 403 AccessDenied, Cloudflare refuses the R2 mirror key (factory-r2-public-mirror). No exporter tests it. Allow the egress IP in its IP filter (FactoryEgressIPChanged runbook, step 2), or replace the key.

FactoryHealthUnhealthy and FactoryHealthStale replace the hub's Honeycomb trigger "jomcgi.dev /health composite unhealthy" (aJgkA4vC2m8) on https://jomcgi.dev/health. HOME-261 removes that trigger and the hub route.
